description: Replaces the text of an internal note left on a thread, for a typo, a wrong figure or a word that no longer holds. The note keeps its author, its place and its files, and shows it was corrected ("updated_at" in get_conversation). Allowed to the author of the note and to a manager or the owner of the account; anyone else is refused. Same rules on the text as add_note: plain text, up to 10000 characters. The note is named by its id, as "notes" of get_conversation gives it.

body.description: The new text of the note, plain text, up to 10000 characters.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it.

note_id.description: The id of the note, as "notes" of get_conversation gives it.

name: update_note
title: Correct an internal note
